versions.changelog:
amazon-analyse 1.0.0 - Initial Release

- Provides comprehensive, multi-dimensional analysis of Amazon competitor listings, covering copy logic, review sentiment, keyword strategies, and market dynamics.
- Automatically generates and saves a structured Markdown analysis report to the reports/ directory.
- Utilizes Sorftime MCP API for real-time Amazon data collection and analysis via curl POST and SSE.
- Includes detailed instructions and best practices for workflow, data retrieval, and exporting reports.
- Activated with the /amazon-analyse command and ASIN input.
